title: AttachmentSavePayload
description:
`workspace.attachment_save` payload (composer attachment, additive).

The host re-validates everything (workspace/conversation ownership, byte size after decode, extension/magic allow-list, filename sanitize) and returns the canonical metadata; the client hints are not trusted.

data_base64.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the raw file bytes.

mime.description: Client-declared MIME (host re-derives it from the extension/magic).

name.description: Client-declared basename (host sanitizes; path separators rejected).
